data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Helene is derived from Helios, the Greek god of the sun. The name Helene means 'shining light' or 'torch of the sun'. In Greek mythology, Helene was the daughter of King Priam of Troy and the sister of Hector. She was famed for her beauty, which led to the Trojan War.

in_latin.name: Helene
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Helene origine a Graecis ortum est, significans feminam pacis, feminam sanctitatis. In tempore antiquo, Helene vocabulum designavit sanctam feminam, quae in mundo pacem et sanctitatem afferret. Hae significatio Helene in cultura Christiana persistit, ut indicem feminae virtutem et sanctitatem.
